name: Niko Price
event: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Duncan
summary: A 37-year-old action fighter returning from a brief retirement for a last dance after four straight losses (Chiesa by submission, Veretennikov by KO); the knee injury and stoppage losses have taken their toll.

how_they_fight.Striking: Wild, high-volume power (about 5.2 a minute), famous for strange finishes.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Scrambles; submitted twice in the recent skid.
how_they_fight.Defense: Absorbs about 5 a minute; stopped repeatedly lately.

keys_to_beat: Stay composed and pick him apart

news.text: Unretires for one final fight after his UFC Seattle exit was overshadowed.

sources.title: Snubbed knockout artist Niko Price returns from retirement for last dance at UFC Vegas 122
